G: the finite undirected graph in the theorem
m: the positive odd integer equal to the length of W
v_i: the vertex at index i on an arbitrary cycle
i: an integer index along the arbitrary cycle
j: an integer index greater than i with v_i=v_j
A: one class of the bipartition constructed or assumed for G
B: the other class of the bipartition constructed or assumed for G
r_H: the chosen root vertex of the connected component H
d(z): the minimum length of a path from the chosen root of z's component to z
k: the length of the arbitrary cycle
x: one endpoint of an arbitrary edge xy
y: the other endpoint of an arbitrary edge xy
P_x: a shortest path from r_H to x
P_y: a shortest path from r_H to y
